create_nested_dict_from_tuples: create a NestedDict from a list of tuple-key value pairs like (('a','b'), 42)
access_nested_dict_with_tuple_keys: access nested values using tuple keys like x['b','c'] to get or set data
filter_nested_dict_by_keys: filter a NestedDict to keep only specified key paths using the filter method
validate_data_with_spec_dict: validate numpy or jax array data against dm_env specs using SpecDict validate
flatten_nested_dict_with_jax_tree: flatten and map over a NestedDict using jax tree_flatten tree_map utilities
